consequence.statement: No operational consequence for an operator upgrading through the normal release path: the new CRD is installed with the release and the new Operation API becomes available; no existing resources or settings are affected, and the only guidance is to install or update CRDs before upgrading if they are managed separately from the release.
consequence.remediation: If you manage Crossplane CRDs separately from the release, install or update them (including ops.crossplane.io_operations.yaml) before upgrading.

assertion.statement: A new CRD, operations.ops.crossplane.io, is added between v1.20.1 and v2.0.0, serving the ops.crossplane.io/v1alpha1 Operation API; the release ships the CRD (cluster/crds/ops.crossplane.io_operations.yaml), and operators who manage Crossplane CRDs separately from the release are instructed to install or update CRDs before upgrading.
